name: Bicolored Agapostemon
desc: Bicolored Agapostemon (Agapostemon virescens): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 36 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Agapostemon virescens, the bicolored striped sweat bee, is a species of sweat bee in the family Halictidae. It is found in North America, and is the official bee of the city of Toronto.
